description: This PHP class defines a Data Access Object (DAO) for managing OAuthClient entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, counting, and deleting OAuthClient records from the database, utilizing query builder wrappers and repositories.

classes.name: OAuthClientDao
classes.description: DAO class for OAuthClient entity, providing persistence and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: saveOAuthClient
methods.description: Saves an OAuthClient entity to the database.

methods.name: getOAuthClientList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OAuthClient entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getOAuthClientCount
methods.description: Counts the number of OAuthClient entities matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getOAuthClientQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Creates and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper instance for OAuthClient queries with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getOAuthClientById
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuthClient entity by its ID.

methods.name: getOAuthClientByClientId
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuthClient entity by its clientId.

methods.name: deleteOAuthClients
methods.description: Deletes OAuthClient entities matching the provided IDs.
